# PR #551 final independent audit

**CHANGES_REQUIRED.** Two introduced defects in the new API tests require correction. The stored-first projection and the D186 documentation meet the selected contract. Formal general review **3 of 3**, as dispatched to GPT-6.2 Astra MAX. [Pull request](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/551)

| Binding | Audited value |
| --- | --- |
| Head | `cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794` |
| Target main | `a84f988b89e456b0e2270e3c4750afb250b6c68f` |
| Head and CI tree | `0a66cc140df841089751801703376dac537fb897` |
| CI synthetic merge | `230071badafb3a250667083ae5dc3718e95c3359` |
| Scope | 396 changed paths against main, including 387 archived files |

## Findings

**F1 · P2 · The new regression tests can contact the developer’s Ollama.** The test environment supplies the data directory, database URL, key and process defaults. It leaves Ollama enabled at the default loopback address. Two positive cases and two disabled-default cases call `container.start()`. The injected Codex and Claude harnesses and `startTimers: false` leave the Ollama override unset. Container startup starts the real Ollama service before checking the timer setting. On these fresh fixtures, that service reads its enabled default, uses the process fetch implementation and requests `/api/tags` at `127.0.0.1:11434`. A responding endpoint with installed models can trigger version and per-model metadata requests. The ordinary test setup configures API port allocation. [New environment](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/apps/api/src/preflight-catalog.test.ts#L39) · [Positive starts](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/apps/api/src/preflight-catalog.test.ts#L133) · [Disabled starts](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/apps/api/src/preflight-catalog.test.ts#L265) · [Ollama defaults](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/apps/api/src/config.ts#L36) · [Container startup](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/apps/api/src/container.ts#L560) · [Discovery](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/packages/infrastructure/src/ollama/discovery.ts#L80)

This entire test file is absent at both the runtime parent and target main. Existing tests also use the service. The independent QA guard recorded ten blocked requests during a three-file suite, six from one worker and four from another. The guard records no test filename or stack. The new source establishes the introduced reachability independently of request-by-request attribution. Set `GG_OLLAMA_ENABLED` to `false` in the test’s own environment or inject an isolated service. Verify the single file through its ordinary test entry point with an outbound observer, retaining startup and catalog assertions and expecting zero requests to the host endpoint. [Service selection](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/apps/api/src/container.ts#L278) · [Default fetch](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/packages/infrastructure/src/ollama/services.ts#L25) · [Ordinary setup](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/apps/api/api-ports.setup.ts) · [Guarded requests](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-448-preflight/independent/qa-01/commands/20-api-focused.fetch-guard.jsonl)

**F2 · P2 · The new storage assertions reject documented empty-WAL creation.** The `storeBytes` helper returns a map keyed by the database filename and whichever WAL exists. The unqualified deep comparisons in the positive, negative and startup-refusal tests require the same keys before and after. These fixtures checkpoint and close SQLite and do not establish that a WAL exists at the initial snapshot. When the first reader creates a permitted zero-byte WAL, the key count changes even with identical database bytes and stored rows. I compared that predicate to the retained P01 observation. The database retained its SHA-256 and all 11 rows, while the directory gained an empty WAL and a 32 KiB SHM. Strict equality would reject that recorded outcome. The ordinary hosted tests passed on their fixtures. [Snapshot implementation](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/apps/api/src/preflight-catalog.test.ts#L73) · [Positive comparison](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/apps/api/src/preflight-catalog.test.ts#L125) · [Negative comparison](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/apps/api/src/preflight-catalog.test.ts#L246) · [Refusal comparison](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/apps/api/src/preflight-catalog.test.ts#L259) · [P01 observation](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-448-preflight/independent/qa-01/observations/run-02/P01.json)

Compare database bytes exactly. If a WAL existed, require it to remain present and byte-identical, including an initially empty one. If the WAL was absent, accept absence or a newly created zero-byte file and reject any added content. Exercise a disposable checkpointed store with a verified absent WAL before the first read. Preserve the existing frozen, nonempty-WAL control and the row and migration checks. P03’s 16,512-byte WAL already contained four frames and stayed byte-identical. P18’s pre-existing empty WAL stayed present and unchanged. [Existing WAL test](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/apps/api/src/preflight-catalog.test.ts#L279) · [P03](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-448-preflight/independent/qa-01/observations/run-02/P03.json) · [P18](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-448-preflight/independent/qa-01/observations/run-02/P18.json)

## Runtime and selected wording

The common helper builds a fresh array from stored rows in input order, then appends shipped entries whose exact harness/model pair is absent. It preserves stored metadata and disabled preferences without mutating inputs. Startup invokes it at pre-write admission. The offline command invokes it after a current, migrated store supplies its read-only catalog. Server-side preflight still reads its live catalog. The runtime diff adds no CLI invocation, provider request, offline migration, seed or refresh. Disabled Codex retains WARN/exit 0, disabled configured Claude retains FAIL/exit 1, and startup continues to reject structurally invalid defaults while making Settings available to repair disabled selections. Native P01/P03 left 11 rows. S01/S02 booted and seeded 13. [Projection](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/packages/infrastructure/src/sqlite/settings.ts#L458) · [Startup](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/apps/api/src/container.ts#L222) · [Offline source](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/apps/api/src/preflight.ts#L645) · [QA final](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/551#issuecomment-7062005567)

I compared all four Claude-authored passages in QA sections 7a–7c to the frozen documentation and integrated Git tree. Their bytes match. The Codex warning cell also matches the prior table. The text accurately permits SHM creation or update and creation of an empty WAL. It distinguishes a configured Claude default from an absent configuration and preserves the harness-specific readiness outcomes. The unchanged guard and isolated Node SQLite reader show the sidecar behavior on this host. Base-binary parity remains a source-backed inference. [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/CHANGELOG.md#L7) · [Preflight documentation](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/docs/11-security-and-distribution.md#L157) · [D186](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/448#issuecomment-7061732566)

## Review, QA and current CI

Actual Opus 5.5/xhigh review 1 approved runtime `b45807f0`. Actual shared review 2 accepted the #448 table correction at `083d7264` and retained its separate #427/#365 slice. I checked their launch records, model usage, complete event streams, final text and exit-zero terminals. QA session 01 ended on HTTP 429, exit 1, without a final verdict. The independent continuation exited zero with **CONDITIONAL PASS**, preserved verbatim on #551 and #448. The selected prose received its GPT review within this third formal slot. [General review 1](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/448#issuecomment-7060237320) · [Shared review 2](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/547#issuecomment-7060697996) · [QA on #448](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/448#issuecomment-7062005873)

| Independent native result | Run 01 | Run 02 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Cases passed / failed | 18 / 22 | 41 / 1 |
| Checks total / failed | 515 / 49 | 580 / 1 |
| Owned API children | 29 | 30 |
| Startup children, including bootstrap | 12 | 12 |

Run 01’s stricter sidecar predicate caught the former documentation error. Run 02 explicitly allowed a new empty WAL and recorded it in 13 offline cases. C12 retained 55 passes and one EBUSY failure, with the same failure class in an unchanged baseline test. C13 recorded delayed file release and the run-02 reader required explicit GC for immediate cleanup. The focused API suite passed 61 tests under its separate guard. Run 02 recorded 154 fake CLI probes and 22 local Ollama metadata requests. PID 35168 belonged to an earlier gateway that exited before its number reappeared in the test-worker guard log. The author’s interrupted, overly broad run has incomplete raw output. Independent Windows QA used fake CLIs and a local service. Owner entitlement, browser behavior specific to #448, non-Windows or restricted filesystem behavior, and a subsequent writer remain outside that evidence. [Preserved QA evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-448-preflight/README.md)

Hosted run `44899676928`, attempt 1, passed all six jobs against the exact head and target. The retained logs report 10,045 unit passes, 52 skipped, 488 browser passes and 27 native Windows passes. All four recorded metrics met 90% across 13 coverage summaries. Coverage completed 22 Turbo tasks. Repository checks and the template image passed. The dependency audit reported seven low and thirteen moderate findings. The native ZIP `14705995694` matched GitHub’s SHA-256 `7ff0d91f0258189f84ed1f1c53829e2c488330b08fdd6469a90ec53293924231`. I compared all three downloaded members byte-for-byte with the retained canonical replay, verified its helper hash and checked the 338 observation records and synthetic-merge parents. This audit used live read-only queries and retained executions. [CI](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/44899676928) · [Published CI receipt](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/551#issuecomment-7062348753)

## Archive, scope and closure

I verified all 387 #448 Git blobs against the archive commit and current checkout, the 386-member internal seal, all 378 copied originals, and all 14 retained local SQLite files against the 392-member selection. All 51 overlapping source, build and fixture checks matched. All 29 ignored logs are present. The earlier selection accounts for 307 proposed copies and 14 local files, with one documented prelaunch brief correction. The bounded privacy scan returned zero candidates against its five recorded patterns. The 223-file integration record, 243 inherited #547 blobs, three additive conflict resolutions, 1,572 protected blob matches and two inherited comment-only source changes agree with the Git trees. The companion binding records the hashes and scope. [Archive map](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-448-preflight/archive-selection.json) · [Seal](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-448-preflight/archive-seal.json)

The draft PR references #448 and #279 as “Part of.” GitHub reports zero closing references, submitted reviews and review threads. #448 remains open for owner-only closure. The owner checklist and decision review remain pending. Parked #545/#546, retirement policy #262, Mac #501, held #460 and #459 owner work have separate dispositions. This verdict holds the exact head for the two test corrections. [Tracking issue](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/448)

# D194 — Correct #448 test isolation and storage assertions after final scan3

Accept both P2 findings in the fresh final Astra scan3 report 2fce1a2eece95028799d3a17dbaa71cd5194b585f417e19111ef4f375ee86c89 at cc0a52cffe7e0bffb197c3f3342d370e2b1b9794 / target a84f988b89e456b0e2270e3c4750afb250b6c68f. The runtime projection and all four D186 prose passages passed that audit. No production change is selected.

Fix only the introduced preflight-catalog test file. Its local environment must explicitly disable Ollama discovery, while retaining actual container startup and catalog assertions. Verify the isolated file with an outbound observer and no host endpoint access. Historical ten blocked requests came from three files and cannot be assigned to this file; do not rewrite them as ten new-file requests.

Replace the overly strict DB/WAL file-map equality with the selected D186 contract: database bytes identical; any initially existing WAL must remain present with identical bytes, including an empty WAL; an initially absent WAL may remain absent or become exactly empty, never nonempty. Exercise a verified absent-WAL disposable fixture and retain the frozen nonempty-WAL control, rows and migration checks. Include negative controls for database mutation, existing-WAL mutation/removal and newly added frames. No weakening of stored-data immutability or SQLite runtime adjustment.

Select bounded GPT Sol xhigh implementation, actual Claude Fable xhigh corrective review, separate actual Claude Opus xhigh behavior QA, then fresh exact-head/current-target CI and canonical native verification. All three general scans are consumed: apply the existing D035/D042 finite completion path and explicit coordinator completion; no fourth general scan or renewed Astra approval. Preserve the negative final report, prior failed/conditional QA and all original archives verbatim. #448 remains open for owner-only closure.

Why: default host discovery is inappropriate for this deterministic fixture, and rejecting supported empty-WAL creation contradicts the accepted contract. Decline treating passing hosted CI as exoneration, changing the shared discovery service, deleting startup cases, suppressing all WAL checks, rewriting prior evidence or changing settled D186 prose. Delegated blocker authority selects this correction; the owner can sign off or rework it in the consolidated decision review before owner QA.
